newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares mixed in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares mixed in higher trade.

text.p: Latvian shares were mixed in higher trade on Friday after being laid low by a four-day weekend, dealers said.

Overall market volume was a relatively active 83,000 lats compared to Thursday's sluggish trade of 39,000 lats and the bourse index crept up 0.06 percent to 383.20 while the Rietumu index climbed 0.2 percent to 153.53.
The official list was mixed, with two of its five stocks holding steady, two rising and only the Riga Transport Fleet easing. It shed two santimes to 1.17 lats in trade of 4,400 lats.
Brokers remained upbeat about about the stock, saying that its first half results are expected to be good.
Traditional market leader Unibanka was in relative demand in trade of 42,700 lats at the unchanged price of 3.35 lats.
Dealers said its price has stabilised and could help keep other shares afloat.

The struggling market has suffered from a lack of liquidity and large companies and competition from the local debt market and privatisation vouchers, which are currently more attractive to investors.
